config.imageAlt: A wall-mounted lamp lighting a textured wall in the dark
config.label: (overview)
config.paragraphOne: A wall-mounted light illuminates a dark interior with a warm, soft glow. Its light spreads across the textured wall, emphasizing the subtle woven surface and creating a gentle gradient of light and shadow.
config.paragraphTwo: A slender pull switch hangs beside the lamp, adding a small vertical accent to the composition. Much of the frame remains in darkness, allowing the illuminated wall and the contrast between warm light and deep shadow to define the atmosphere.

name: Story — Constellation
description: Six-act constellation sequence: stars seed, link into a web, migrate into the shape of the word, hold, then release back into drift

name: Story — Countdown Ignition
description: Six-act countdown: three numbers slam in with shockwave rings, the last one detonates into shards, the word lands, then everything settles out

name: Story — Grid Sweep
description: Five-act shutter sequence: a tile grid covers the stage, a sweep flips each tile open to uncover the word beneath, it holds, then the tiles close again

name: Story — Liquid Fill
description: Six-act fill sequence: the word is drawn as an outline, a stream pours in, the level rises, sloshes, drains and leaves the outline empty

name: Story — Orbit Capture
description: Six-act letter sequence: characters arrive scattered, fall into a shared orbit, are captured one at a time into their place in the word, lock, then let go

name: Story — Scan & Decode
description: Five-act decode sequence: a scan line sweeps noise into place, characters resolve one by one, the word locks in brackets, glitches, then scrambles away

name: Story — Type & Shatter
description: Six-act type sequence: the word types itself in, holds, shatters into particles, drifts apart, reforms and settles
